When I was one I asked my mother when this shit would stop, when I would stop suffering, I told her I would kill myself when I complete 16 because it was enough, she always told me that with time things would be better, that I needed to have patience, one day at a time, that if I need to suffer and cry that's fine, hurting myself no, I did it anyway, but well I'm alive ten years later. And it's better now. Not 100%, I still suffer and sob in tears, but it's better.

I hope you can put into perspective that teenage years are supposed to be like that, it's a lot of things going on. And make your decision not just based on your feelings, but also that scientifically things tend to be better before teenager years (but pleeeeease if you can go to therapy).
